summary_en: 57,274,900 shares sold at ¥3,401/share (6.01% of shares outstanding) for ¥194.8B. Stake reduced from 42.38% to 35.28%. Settlement scheduled 2026-07-09. Operating profit impact: ¥86B (FY3/27).
title_en: Notice regarding results of public tender offer by JX Metals Co., Ltd. for its own shares
translation_en_brief: This disclosure reports the final results of a public tender offer by JX Metals Co., Ltd. for its own shares, to which ENEOS Holdings had decided to subscribe on 2026-05-11. The purchase price was calculated as the lower of (i) the simple average closing price of JX Metals shares over the one-month period ending 2026-05-08, or (ii) the closing price on 2026-05-20, with a 10% discount applied. The one-month average was ¥4,848 and the 2026-05-20 close was ¥3,779; applying the 10% discount to the lower figure yielded a final sale price of ¥3,401 per share. ENEOS sold 57,274,900 shares for a total of ¥194.8B, reducing its stake in JX Metals from 42.38% to 35.28%. The purchase price of ¥3,401/share was lower than the ¥4,363/share assumed in the earlier announcement, resulting in a revised operating profit impact of ¥86B for the fiscal year ending 2027-03 (down from the initially projected ¥110B). Settlement is scheduled for 2026-07-09.
